title: 第七课 · 你家有几口人
subtitle: Lesson 7 — 你家有几口人 · How many people in your family?

items.py: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
items.en: How many people are in your family?

items.py: Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
items.en: There are five people in my family.
Do you have siblings?
What does your father do?
My father is a doctor.

items.zh: 玛丽：王兰，你家有几口人？
items.py: Mǎlì: Wáng Lán, nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
items.en: Mary: Wang Lan, how many people are in your family?

items.zh: 王兰：我家有四口人。我爸爸、我妈妈、我妹妹和我。
items.py: Wáng Lán: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. Wǒ bàba, wǒ māma, wǒ mèimei hé wǒ.
items.en: Wang Lan: There are four in my family — my dad, my mom, my younger sister, and me.
Mary: Do you have an older brother?

items.zh: 王兰：没有，我没有哥哥，只有一个妹妹。
items.py: Wáng Lán: Méiyǒu, wǒ méiyǒu gēge, zhǐ yǒu yí gè mèimei.
items.en: Wang Lan: No, I don't have an older brother — only one younger sister.

items.zh: 玛丽：你爱人也是中国人吗？
items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ àiren yě shì Zhōngguó rén ma?
items.en: Mary: Is your spouse Chinese too?

items.py: Wáng Lán: Wǒ hái méiyǒu àiren ne.
items.en: Wang Lan: I don't have a spouse yet.

items.py: Dàwèi: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
items.en: David: How many people are in your family?

items.zh: 玛丽：我家有五口人。我爸爸、我妈妈、我丈夫、我女儿和我儿子。
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. Wǒ bàba, wǒ māma, wǒ zhàngfu, wǒ nǚ'ér hé wǒ érzi.
items.en: Mary: There are five — my dad, my mom, my husband, my daughter, and my son.

items.zh: 大卫：你爸爸做什么工作？
items.py: Dàwèi: Nǐ bàba zuò shénme gōngzuò?
items.en: David: What does your father do?
Mary: My dad's a doctor.
David: What about your mother?

items.zh: 玛丽：我妈妈是公司的职员。
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ māma shì gōngsī de zhíyuán.
items.en: Mary: My mom is an office worker at a company.

items.zh: 大卫：你丈夫在大学工作吗？
items.py: Dàwèi: Nǐ zhàngfu zài dàxué gōngzuò ma?
items.en: David: Does your husband work at a university?

items.zh: 玛丽：对，他在北京大学工作。
items.py: Mǎlì: Duì, tā zài Běijīng Dàxué gōngzuò.
items.en: Mary: Yes, he works at Peking University.

items.py: Wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén.
items.en: 有 expresses possession or existence ("have" / "there are").
有 + object: to have something.
Negate with 没有, not 不有.
有没有 pattern for yes/no questions about having something.

items.py: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
items.en: 几 asks "how many" for small expected numbers (family size, etc.).
多少 is used for larger or open-ended quantities.

items.py: wǔ kǒu rén · sān gè háizi
items.en: 口 counts family members; 个 is the general measure word.
Use 两 before measure words, not 二 (二口人 is wrong).

items.py: Wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng gè rén.
items.en: 两 + 个 + 人 is fine; 口 is specifically for family headcount.

items.zh: 你家有几口人？——我家有三口人。
items.py: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén? —— Wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén.
items.en: How many in your family? —— Three.

items.zh: 你家有几口人？——我家有四口人。
items.py: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén? —— Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén.
items.en: How many in your family? —— Four.

items.zh: 你家有几口人？——我家有五口人。
items.py: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén? —— Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
items.en: How many in your family? —— Five.

items.zh: 你有没有兄弟姐妹？——我有一个妹妹。
items.py: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi? —— Wǒ yǒu yí gè mèimei.
items.en: Do you have siblings? —— I have one younger sister.

items.zh: 你有没有兄弟姐妹？——我没有兄弟姐妹。
items.py: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi? —— Wǒ méiyǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi.
items.en: Do you have siblings? —— I don't have any.

items.zh: 你有没有姐姐？——我有两个姐姐。
items.py: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu jiějie? —— Wǒ yǒu liǎng gè jiějie.
items.en: Do you have older sisters? —— I have two.

items.zh: 你爸爸做什么工作？——我爸爸是医生。
items.py: Nǐ bàba zuò shénme gōngzuò? —— Wǒ bàba shì yīshēng.
items.en: What does your dad do? —— He's a doctor.

items.zh: 你妈妈做什么工作？——我妈妈是公司职员。
items.py: Nǐ māma zuò shénme gōngzuò? —— Wǒ māma shì gōngsī zhíyuán.
items.en: What does your mom do? —— She's a company employee.

items.py: Qǐngwèn, nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
items.en: Excuse me, how many people are in your family?

items.zh: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、姐姐和我。
items.py: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén: bàba, māma, jiějie hé wǒ.
items.en: There are four of us: dad, mom, older sister, and me.

items.py: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu érzi hé nǚ'ér?
items.en: Do you have a son and a daughter?

items.zh: 我有一个儿子，没有女儿。
items.py: Wǒ yǒu yí gè érzi, méiyǒu nǚ'ér.
items.en: I have one son, no daughter.
What does your wife do?

items.zh: 我爱人在大学工作，她是老师。
items.py: Wǒ àiren zài dàxué gōngzuò, tā shì lǎoshī.
items.en: My spouse works at a university; she's a teacher.

items.zh: 我爸爸和妈妈都在公司工作。
items.py: Wǒ bàba hé māma dōu zài gōngsī gōngzuò.
items.en: Both my father and mother work at a company.

items.zh: 他家没有兄弟姐妹，只有一个孩子。
items.py: Tā jiā méiyǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi, zhǐ yǒu yí gè háizi.
items.en: Their family has no siblings — only one child.
